neighbours.label: the slot after a singular 'one / a single X' where a contrast with many is expected ('one person or [many]'); output promotes many / multiple / several
fire: Does the function handle one request or many at the same time?
Instead of a single server to protect, we may have several thousand.
The tool can analyse one building or an entire portfolio of sites.
A single test is not enough; we need an analysis of many samples.
Is the virus carried by one mosquito species or by several?
You can buy one ticket or a whole book of them at the counter.
The case concerns not one victim but dozens across the region.
Rather than one large meal, try eating several smaller ones.
quiet: Does the function handle requests in the order they arrive?
Instead of a firewall to protect, we may rely on encryption.
The tool can analyse energy use in office buildings.
A careful test is not enough; we need an analysis of the results.
Is the virus carried by mosquitoes in the coastal swamps?
You can buy tickets at the counter or online in advance.
The case concerns a victim who lived across the region.
Rather than a large meal, try eating a lighter salad.

notes: Card: 'one person or many', 'a single case or an analysis of', 'one password file... we may have several thousand', 'one building, or an entire portfolio'. The - pole's output promotes many/multiple/several.
